verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned SharePoint API surfaces: docs refer to the "SharePoint REST v1 API" and the Microsoft Graph SharePoint resource docs sit under the graph-rest-1.0 view. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a version-lifecycle guarantee, which is the core of being able to "rely" on the APIs. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation or breaking-change policy, published version lifecycle and support windows, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
